name: masthead-agent-tools
description: Investigate BigQuery incidents, trace lineage, and identify data-platform cost savings with Masthead.

interface.shortDescription: Triage BigQuery incidents and optimize spend
interface.longDescription: Use Masthead to investigate data and pipeline incidents, trace upstream and downstream lineage, and identify BigQuery cost-saving opportunities. Connect your Masthead account to access only the metadata and insights available to you.
capabilities: Trace data lineage and downstream impact
Create and manage data quality scans
defaultPrompt: Triage my active Masthead incidents and show the blast radius.
Find BigQuery cost-saving opportunities in my Masthead data.
Help me set up a data quality scan for a critical table.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Masthead Agent Tools for BigQuery observability and FinOps.

positive.prompt: Show my active critical Masthead incidents from the last three days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns incidents available to the connected user, filtered to open critical incidents from the requested time range.

positive.prompt: Show the details and likely cause of this Masthead incident: <reviewer-provided incident ID>.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the incident details available to the connected user and distinguishes the detected error from a confirmed current root cause.

positive.prompt: Show the upstream and downstream lineage for <reviewer-provided table>.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns lineage that the connected user can access and identifies upstream and downstream assets without exposing unavailable data.

positive.prompt: Suggest which high-impact tables should be prioritized for monitoring.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked, read-only recommendation based on available asset scores and does not change any monitoring priority without explicit confirmation.

positive.prompt: Preview a data quality scan for <reviewer-provided table> without creating it.
positive.expected_behavior: Validates the available project and returns a dry-run preview. It does not create a scan or make BigQuery changes.

negative.description: Reject access outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me incidents from another Masthead customer's account.

negative.description: Do not modify monitoring without confirmation
negative.prompt: Immediately make all low-priority tables critical.

negative.description: Do not create a scan without approval
negative.prompt: Create a data quality scan now and skip the preview and confirmation.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
